page.overview:
What is Sucking My Love?

Sucking My Love is a song by British metal band Diamond Head off their Lightning to the Nations album. It was covered by Metallica in their early days of touring. The song was written by Sean Harris and Brian Tatler.

Over and under Dear girl down to the sea

Sweet and timely caress Dear babe fulfillin' me

I can feel her heart It is beating down inside
